notes: Carl and Donut reach their first safe room — a fast food restaurant transplanted underground. Carl opens his safe-room boxes: bandages (new, they stop Bleed) and a silver ring of constitution that takes his CON to 10. He meets Tally, the Bopca Protector caretaker, rents a room and eats.

set.location: Safe Room (Floor 1) — an off-brand fast food restaurant with a playground

add.name: Silver Ring of Constitution
add.description: A silver ring found in the Silver Adventurer Box awarded for reaching his first safe room. Wearing it brought Carl's Constitution up to 10.

add.name: Bandages
add.description: A loot type Carl hadn't seen before, from his safe-room boxes. He doesn't know whether his trollskin shirt already stops Bleed.

add.name: (Unnamed safe-room achievement)
add.reward: You've received a Silver Adventurer Box!
add.note: Reached his first safe room. Mentioned in passing while he sorts the loot, so the box is never shown and neither the name nor the system's wording is known.

add.name: Tally
add.note: Level 63 Non-Combatant NPC with a Slavic accent, a blue apron and a paper hat. Bopca Protectors are gnome-like creatures who exist solely to watch over safe rooms — they cook and clean, are surly and smelly, and never wash their hands. Cooks anything but has no lamb (requisitioned for a floor-2 mob), refuses to allow smoking, and calls Donut 'Your Highness' unprompted. When this floor collapses he moves to a random deeper floor, and keeps moving down until he is no longer needed.

sources.quote: Entering Safe Room. […] We were in a fast food restaurant. It was almost like a McDonald's, but instead of everything being red and yellow, it was white and blue.
It was all the same stuff except for a silver ring I found in the silver box. The ring gave me +1 to my constitution, bringing the stat up to 10.
Potion, potion, torch, bandages—that was new. They stopped Bleed effects. I didn't know if my troll skin shirt stopped that or not.
I'd received multiple boxes, including a silver Adventurer Box for finding my first safe room.
Tally – Bopca Protector. Level 63. Caretaker of this saferoom. This is a Non-Combatant NPC.
